name: wallhammer-example-fantasy-village
description: A living fantasy village on wallhammer-web: hand-painted look from vertex colours, procedural architecture, villagers, smoke and fire, late afternoon to evening. Everything from code.

scripts.inspect: vite build --ssr scripts/inspect.ts --outDir node_modules/.inspect --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.inspect/inspect.js
scripts.collisions: vite build --ssr scripts/collisions.ts --outDir node_modules/.collisions --emptyOutDir --logLevel warn && node node_modules/.collisions/collisions.js
